name: Elnathan Topping

events.title: Baptism
events.description: Baptized at Milford, son of Thomas Topping and wife Emma

events.title: Land from his father
events.description: Thomas Topping deeded all his Southampton lands to sons Elnathan and James

bioAdditions: Savage records Elnathan's baptism at Milford on 2 Aug 1640, son of Thomas and Emma Topping, and his father's 1686 deed of the Southampton lands to Elnathan and James (S1). Weygant (1897) gives his birth as 'Aug. 6, 1640' (S2).

conflicts.assessment: Prefer the Milford church baptism of 2 Aug 1640; Weygant's 6 Aug is probably a misreading.

sources.citation: James Savage, A Genealogical Dictionary of the First Settlers of New England, vol. 4 (1862), p. 255, entry TAPPAN/TOPPING, Thomas of Milford
C. H. Weygant, The Family Record (1897; devoted to the Sackett, Weygant and Mapes families and intersecting lines), pp. 144-145, 'Smiths of Smithtown', Generations III-V
